name: Anwuli Nwosu-Thorvaldsdóttir
role: Social engineering and negotiation specialist — face
location: Dockside — Lake Michigan waterfront, smuggler territory, near Lake Shore and Wacker
description:
Anwuli Nwosu-Thorvaldsdóttir is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 25, the augmentation scarring around her temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, she worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. She works as a face out of Dockside, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Anwuli Nwosu-Thorvaldsdóttir has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and she cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "People want to trust someone. I just make sure that someone is me."
"The hardest lock to pick is between someone's ears."
"I don't lie. I tell a better version of the truth."

story_hooks: Kamala Mori-Sefa is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
Someone is impersonating Kamala Mori-Sefa on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A dead drop Kamala Mori-Sefa maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: Kamala Mori-Sefa is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage. Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.
affiliation: Freelance — Geartown regular; The Glass Ladder

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.heritage: Complex multifaceted diaspora: Sub-Saharan African (34.5%) provides deep warm undertones and facial structure; East Asian (21.3%) contributes angular cheekbones and eye shape; Indigenous American (20.9%) adds facial width and bone prominence; Hispanic/Latin American (13.1%) brings warmth and subtle olive notes; Eastern European (10.2%) introduces cooler undertones. Result: richly layered medium-warm golden-brown complexion with subtle olive and cool undertones creating dimensional depth.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible muscle definition in shoulders and forearms; zero excess body fat. Moves with predatory efficiency—every gesture economical, no wasted motion.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with subtle iridescence—natural black with faint chrome-dust sheen from dermal contact
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid. Practical; minimizes visual distraction during negotiations.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with warm amber undertone—baseline human, but gaze registers micro-expressions at inhuman speed
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm golden-brown with olive undertones—Sub-Saharan warmth grounding East Asian and Indigenous American structure, cooled subtly by Eastern European heritage; creates richly complex luminescent complexion under neon from chromatic augmentation
physical_description.complexion: Distinctly angular face reflecting African width in cheekbones, East Asian eye geometry, Indigenous American facial prominence, with Eastern European cool undertones. Cheekbones sharp and defined; jawline strong. Dermal augmentation scarring visible as faint silver lattice work around temples and jawline—deliberately exposed. Minor nick scars on hands and knuckles; occupational. Chemical burn marks on inner right forearm (4cm diameter, adrenaline pump installation site), partially obscured by sleeve when worn.
distinguishing_marks: Augmentation scarring traces along both temples in geometric silver patterns, approximately 3cm each, installed with prioritized function over cosmetic finish
Thin pale scar along left jawline (approximately 2cm), runs from earlobe toward chin—old injury, pre-augmentation
Faint chemical burn marks on inner right forearm (adrenaline pump installation site), approximately 4cm diameter, partially obscured by sleeve when worn
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chromatic dermal camouflage manifests as subtle color-shifting iridescence across exposed skin—neck, hands, forearms shift between matte black, deep blue, and gunmetal gray depending on light angle and biometric state. Effect is unnerving; skin has faint luminescence under neon. Augmentation scarring silver-bright around temples and jawline. No attempt to hide any of it.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed evenly, ready to move in any direction without telegraph. Walks with minimal hip rotation—controlled, lethal efficiency. Makes direct eye contact; blinks slowly, suggesting processing speed enhancement. Hands often at rest position near body center, fingers relaxed but ready. When negotiating, perfectly still; only eyes and face express intent.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional streetwear: Charcoal reinforced tactical jacket (Shin-Kobe Industries surplus, worn deliberately) with integrated armor panels visible at shoulders and forearms. Black compression base layer under jacket. Matte-finish tactical cargo pants with thigh holster (empty by design—signals confidence). Steel-toed boots, scuffed and broken in. No jewelry; too many variables in a contract situation. Lightweight tactical watch with encrypted connection overlay. Everything dark, everything functional. Dockside aesthetic: practical survival wear, not fashion.

Black hair pulled tight in functional braid, subtle chrome-dust sheen. Silver scarring in geometric patterns around temples and jawline from augmentations deliberately exposed.
